speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me if the numbness and tingling extend beyond your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of scabies in your household, and have you noticed any burrows or linear tracks on your skin? I also need to check if you have any neurological deficits in your arms or legs.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a pruritic rash, sensory loss (numbness/tingling), and specific signs like eyebrow thinning and hypopigmented macules strongly suggests leprosy. To confirm the diagnosis and determine the bacterial load, I need to see the lesions up close and test for acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST IMAGES. REQUEST TEST: Slit-skin smear

text:
The positive slit-skin smear confirms your diagnosis. You have multibacillary leprosy, which explains the rash, numbness, and hair loss.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Multibacillary leprosy
